sentences.en: He related to his wife something interesting about his employer.
sentences.zh: 他向妻子讲述了一些关于雇主的有趣事情。

sentences.en: You saw your former employer at a conference, didn't you?
sentences.zh: 你在一次会议上遇到了以前的老板，对吧？

sentences.en: My employer reimburses me for expenses like parking and mileage.
sentences.zh: 我的公司为我报销停车费和里程费用。
